_README.purpose: THE machine-readable geographic source of truth for the Thyrcross world map. Canon doc §5a is the prose summary of this file; sessions answer geometry questions (distance, travel time, which-nation, border crossings) by querying this JSON via scripts/map/, never by eyeballing the PNGs. Regenerate labeled maps with scripts/map/render.py.
_README.coordinates: Full-resolution pixels on source-materials/maps/thyrcross.png (origin top-left; 2236x2976 since the 2026-07-19 redraw). meta.km_per_px converts to km (Ben's ruling 2026-07-12: ~4,000 km north-south).
_README.provenance: Nations/cities extracted from the political layers of Thycross.procreate (OneDrive; gitignored) via scripts/map/extract_procreate.py; polygons traced by scripts/map/trace_regions.py; waterways by scripts/map/trace_rivers.py. meta.source records the .procreate stamp at extraction time — if the file's size/mtime differ, the art has changed and a re-extraction pass is due.
_README.flags: ⚑1 fields mirror the canon doc's provisional-until-Ben-confirms convention. `painted` on sites (and on cities once named): false = Ben's Thycross.procreate doesn't show it yet — scripts/map/paint_overlay.py renders the import-into-Procreate guide layer from these.

meta.scale_basis: Ben's ruling 2026-07-12: ~4,000 km north-south; re-anchored 2026-07-19 on the redrawn canvas (Kettavar N coast y=324 to Canticle S tip y=2853)

travel_modes_km_per_day._note: barge_down 110 = Ben's ruling 2026-07-13 (current does the work; night drift with a steersman on long reaches). barge_up/road/foot are confirmed defaults (2026-07-13).

nations.name: Sylvaneth
nations.region: forested eastern island, off the mainland

land_budget.water_frac_basis: measured 2026-07-20 on the post-gap-fill watertight partition (scripts/map/water_frac.py colour classifier; calibration run in-session: Thalendor reproduced at 14.8% vs recorded 14.7%). Mountain rivers and high tarns - real drawn blue, trusted.
land_budget.cleared_frac_basis: Ben ruling 114: true mountains - high valleys, thin soil, long winters (5b). Only valley floors and low benches take a plow; harsher than Malcurr's 10% cold uplands (ruling 71), above nothing. Roughly two-thirds of cleared land is hay meadow rather than bread grain - that split falls out of the herd dial, not a separate dial.
land_budget.yield_mult_basis: ruling 114: no named or derivable leyline yield bonus - Vorsk's ground is Red/Black (ruling 35), neither a growth frequency; the ruling-63 pattern pins no Green line through the ranges.
land_budget.kcal_per_ha_year_basis: ruling 114: Malcurr's cold-climate blend adopted (ruling 71 class) - short season, hardy grains (barley/oats/rye), heavy meadow share. Same sourced-but-adjustable dial class as ruling 27's 2.5M.
land_budget.livestock_units_per_person_basis: ruling 114: pastoral mountain composition - sheep-heavy transhumance (~5-6 sheep/goat equivalents per LU; ~4.5-5.5M head nationally). Above Malcurr's 0.26 default: the herd is the economy, not a sideline.
land_budget.pasture_feed_frac_basis: ruling 114: the transhumance term - HALF the herd's annual feed comes off the unclearable high pastures (summer on the alps costs the farm nothing; winter is stall-fed on meadow hay). This is Vorsk's explicit uncounted term (the Lunavar-class exception, ruling 62 pattern), entering as FEED, not food: it halves the herd's farm bill instead of adding a diet share directly. The set-aside of ruling 27 is untouched - no fish term (landlocked; mountain streams marginal).
land_budget.import_frac_human_kcal_basis: ruling 114 sizing what ruling 93 already made load-bearing ('every high valley eats through a Goldenport countersign'): 8% of human calories arrive as Ledger grain bought with ore - ~53,000 tons/yr up the ore road (~125-175 km from the western border down to Goldenport's north-coast ports, city-04/-11/-17; measured 2026-07-20 on the watertight partition). Concentrated in the mining valleys - which is why a raid on the Port starves the raider's own valley by spring.
land_budget.livestock_kcal_year_note: farm-fed HALF of total herd feed only (total herd feed 8.76T; the high pastures carry the other 4.38T off-model per pasture_feed_frac).
land_budget.population_basis: valley-and-ledger model (ruling 114): P = F / (0.92 x 730k + 0.5 x 0.30 x 9.125M) = 6.539T / 2.0404M = ~3.2M - the SMALLEST measured population on the 7th-largest land (689,068 km2; current gazetteer areas). Farmland alone at the Malcurr-form budget would carry ~1.9M; the two non-farm legs (high-pasture feed relief + Ledger grain) lift carrying capacity ~70% - roughly a third of Vorsk is fed by legs that are NOT farmland, which is the structural derivation of both the ritualized subsistence raiding (5b Taking-law economics) and the Peace of the Ledger (ruling 93). Implied ~98 persons/km2 of farmland - above the 80 midpoint (ruling 26), honestly earned by imports and pasture, not by yield. THE BUFFER IS ONE-SHOT: unlike the grain nations (ruling 27's convertible livestock buffer - cull the herd, eat the freed grain for years), Vorsk's herd is backed by hay and alp grass humans cannot eat. Culling feeds the valleys for a year or two of meat, then the meadows grow grass for animals that no longer exist - the margin invariant's ~3.3x cushion does not exist here in convertible form, which is WHY the raiding is permanent ritualized subsistence rather than an emergency lever, and why Vorsk raids at the first pinch, not the last. FAMINE: layer-1 locks 15%-and-rising of the farm base (ruling 25) AND the murrain lands directly on the buffer itself - herds that sicken and will not finish dying, uncullable-clean (ruling 24) - while the famine premium (ruling 56) shrinks what the ore buys. Net: rationing-tier hunger (ruling 56 class), cliff visible but not arrived (ruling 19 scale discipline), and the raid escalation is ruling 67's clock with its economics now underneath it. HOSPICE (ruling 115 - the going-up): gross wasting accrual ~3%/yr (mountain winters, hunger), but the going-up custom clears most cases that reach the asking - NET ~1%/yr standing accrual -> ~64,000 stuck-dying two years in, one household in TEN touched: visible in every valley, drowning no one - the inverse of Corvaine/Malcurr, purchased by the quiet shelves.
land_budget.note: Normal-times budget (ruling 114). area 689,068 - 5.1% water = 653,925 dry; x5% cleared = 32,696 raw = effective (no leyline bonus). Farm production 6.539T kcal/yr; humans draw 2.149T (92% of need - Ledger grain covers the rest), farm-fed herd share 4.38T. Approved by Ben 2026-07-20 (Vorsk dive, section 1).

land_budget.water_frac_basis: re-measured 2026-07-19 on the redrawn map: Rivers-and-Lakes LAYER alpha inside the new polygon (direct layer measure, no colour classifier). Previous basis: measured 2026-07-19: 8.5% Rivers-and-Lakes blue inside the polygon (scripts/map/water_frac.py on thyrcross.png; classifier calibrated against Thalendor's recorded 11.7%, reproduced at 11.5%). Unlike Lunavar's marsh, the tree-of-lakes IS real drawn water - the measurement is trusted.
land_budget.cleared_frac_basis: Ben ruling 71: cold uplands - arable confined to valley bottoms and lakeshores; the fells are rough grazing folded into the kcal blend, not plowland. Between forest-capped Thalendor (15%) and Lunavar's built paddy (6%).
land_budget.yield_mult_basis: ruling 71: no named or derivable leyline yield bonus - the ruling-63 pattern pins no Green line through Malcurr.
land_budget.kcal_per_ha_year_basis: ruling 71: cold-climate blend below the continental 2.5M (ruling 27) - short season, hardy grains (barley/oats/rye), heavy pasture share. Same sourced-but-adjustable dial class.
land_budget.livestock_units_per_person_basis: ruling 71: default composition (ruling 27) - the species mix is sheep-heavy on the fells (~1.8 sheep-equivalents per person), herd country in look with no new dial.
land_budget.population_basis: cold-upland model (ruling 71): P = F / (730k + 0.26 x 9.125M) = 19.94T / 3.1025M = ~6.4M - FOURTH most populous (behind Corvaine 14.1M, Thalendor 13.1M, Lunavar 12.2M): the LARGEST nation on the map (1,089,432 km2, edging Thalendor) carrying a middling population, which is what cold uplands should do. Implied ~64 persons/km2 of farmland - leaner than the 80 midpoint, honestly earned by the cold. THE LAKE-LARDER FORK RESOLVED DOWN (unlike Lunavar's ruling-62 exception): canon never calls Malcurr hungry (ruling 56) and cold deep glacial lakes are nutrient-poor - thin fisheries, always supplementary - so fish calories stay set aside per ruling 27. The lakes were never the larder; they are the ROADS (the tree-of-lakes is the national transport network - boats and portages, forge-towns between the arms). Environmental layer live and derived: one connected waterway system, so the blight in it never clears (ruling 24) and stuck catch passes the wasting (ruling 34) - the catch is untrusted, the fishery has effectively closed (texture, not a model term). FAMINE: at layer-1-only yield (85%) production ~16.95T dwarfs the 4.67T human need -> Malcurr is CALORICALLY WHOLE; herds cull ~20% (1.67M -> ~1.34M units); starvation cliff at ~23.4% of normal yield. HOSPICE (ruling 72): ~4%/yr net wasting accrual (vs Corvaine's 3, ruling 41 - the boats spread the wasting along every arm) -> ~8% stuck-dying two years in = ~510,000, one household in three touched; Corvaine domesticated the burden, Malcurr INDUSTRIALIZED it (Lamp-tenders + island still-houses concentrate care), which is why the forges run and the Warlock has the easy coin that funds Corvaine's war (ruling 30).
land_budget.note: Normal-times budget (ruling 71). area 1,089,432 - 8.5% water = 996,830 dry; x10% cleared = 99,683 raw = effective (no leyline yield bonus).

nations.name: Lunavar
nations.region: mid-west marsh/scrubland, west of the central forest

land_budget.water_frac_basis: re-measured 2026-07-19 on the redrawn map: Rivers-and-Lakes LAYER alpha inside the new polygon (direct layer measure, no colour classifier). Previous basis: measured 2026-07-19: 2.4% Rivers-and-Lakes blue inside the polygon (scripts/map/water_frac.py on thyrcross.png; classifier calibrated against Thalendor's recorded 11.7%, reproduced at 11.5%). NOTE: the marsh itself is stylized terrain art, NOT drawn water - like the forest green it is unmeasurable; the wetland reality lives in the cleared/marsh dials instead.
land_budget.cleared_frac_basis: Ben ruling 62: paddy land is BUILT, not merely cleared - bunds, levees, and water-control confined to the rises and margins; the wet heart is larder, not plowland; the dry scrub fringe adds little. Below forest-capped Thalendor (15%) and river-plain Corvaine (25%).
land_budget.yield_mult_basis: ruling 63: the Westward Green line (Root Network -> west coast, co-peaking with Blue at Goldenport's Life nexus per ruling 11) crosses ~300 km of southern Lunavar; x1.25 yield on 30% of farmland (the southern ridge districts, kept well below heartland-wide so ridge country feels distinct) = x1.075 overall. CURRENTLY FAILED: Verdannis's continent-wide drain has dropped the ridge districts back to x1.0 - nothing fails to sprout (Thalendor's signature stays unique); the failed bonus is the whisper-grade drain mark.
land_budget.kcal_per_ha_year_basis: ruling 62: the staple is PADDY RICE - intensive cropping, no fallow, low seed rates - so Lunavar runs above the continental 2.5M mixed-farming blend (ruling 27). 4.0M kcal/ha/yr net is conservative against pre-industrial wet-rice; same sourced-but-adjustable dial class as the 2.5M.
land_budget.livestock_units_per_person_basis: ruling 62: no cattle country - household pigs, goats, and waterfowl in cattle-equivalents (ducks in the paddies); the herd-buffer role the continent's 0.26 LU/person plays elsewhere was played by the marsh larder here.
land_budget.marsh_diet_frac_basis: ruling 62 - THE Lunavar-scoped exception to ruling 27's fish set-aside (explicitly superseding it for this nation only): the marsh harvest (fish, eel, fowl, reed-root) fed one-third of normal human calories. Without this term the standard chain pegs humans at ~23.4% of farm production and cannot produce ruling 56's approved 'genuinely short of calories'.
land_budget.population_basis: rice-and-marsh model (rulings 62-63): P = F / (730k x (1 - marsh_frac) + 9.125M x LU_per_person) = 14.86T / 1.2167M = ~12.2M - third most populous nation (behind Corvaine 14.1M, Thalendor 13.1M), which is why everyone's hungry neighbor raids the delta. Implied ~330 persons/km2 of cropland - the intensive wet-rice density, honestly earned by rice + marsh (the continental 80/km2 mixed-farming dial does not apply). FAMINE (ruling 62): the marsh is one connected water-sheet - layer-1 contagion in it never clears (the plague-well persistence, ruling 24, at landscape scale) and eating stuck-wasting catch passes the wasting (ruling 34), so the catch is UNTRUSTED = the wet third of the larder is closed. With 15% of paddy blight-locked and the ridge bonus failed, farm output runs ~79% of normal (11.75T) against a human need of 8.91T - fed only by liquidating the lean herd (~68% culled two years in) while Vorsk skims the caches. Starvation cliff at ~60% of normal farm yield, closing ~7 pts/yr plus raids. Hunger real and worsening (fast-days as rationing, ruling 56), mass death not yet (ruling 19).
land_budget.note: Normal-times budget (ruling 62). area 590,112 - 2.4% water = 575,949 dry; x6% built/cleared = 34,557 raw; x1.075 (Westward line, ruling 63) = 37,149 effective.

nations.name: Thalendor
nations.region: the great central forest (Root Network heartland)

land_budget.water_frac_basis: re-measured 2026-07-19 on the redrawn map: Rivers-and-Lakes LAYER alpha inside the new polygon (direct layer measure, no colour classifier). Previous basis: measured 2026-07-13: 11.7% Rivers-and-Lakes blue inside the polygon (thyrcross.png, polygon-masked); lake country
land_budget.cleared_frac_basis: Ben ruling 26: deep revered forest (Root Network shrine-groves, never-cut) caps clearing; the Network's yield bonus lets it stay low
land_budget.kcal_per_ha_year_basis: ruling 27 dial: net-of-seed digestible energy, pre-industrial mixed farming blended over crop/fallow/pasture; Root Network bonus already in the effective-hectare count. Human-only floor is 585k kcal/ha. Adjustable.
land_budget.population_basis: farmland ONLY (rulings 26-27, re-derived ruling 85 on the redrawn area): ruling-85 chain 1,228,722 km2 - 14.7% water = 1,048,100 dry x 15% cleared = 157,215 raw; Root Network x1.15 = 180,797 eff km2 x 80/km2 = ~14.5M. Calorie balance (ruling 27, rescaled): 18.08M ha x 2.5M kcal/ha = 45.2T kcal/yr; humans 14.5M x 730k = 10.59T (~23%); remaining 34.6T feeds ~3.79M cattle-equivalent livestock units (~0.26/person). Fish set aside (ruling 27). FAMINE ratios scale-invariant (ruling 85): at 42.5% yield humans stay calorically whole; livestock craters ~75%; the mass-death cliff sits at 23.4% of normal yield.
land_budget.note: Normal-times farmland (rulings 26/85). Chain uses ruling-85 area 1,228,722 km2 (area_km2_approx is the same redrawn-polygon measure, rounded separately). Under both famine layers effective yield falls to 42.5% ~= 76,800 km2-equivalent.

land_budget.water_frac_basis: re-measured 2026-07-19 on the redrawn map: Rivers-and-Lakes LAYER alpha inside the new polygon (direct layer measure, no colour classifier) - inlet-cut coast but little standing inland water.
land_budget.cleared_frac_basis: W27 section-1 dial (Ben approved 2026-07-19): between forest-capped Thalendor (15%) and river-plain Corvaine (25%) - no revered-forest taboo caps clearing and the coastal lowlands farm well, but a maritime-mercantile economy whose interior rises toward Vorsk's ranges and Ashkar's badlands clears what feeds it, not to the horizon.
land_budget.yield_mult_basis: ruling 89: the Life nexus (Blue/Green co-peak, ruling 11) carries a natural Root-Network-class bonus - x1.25 yield on the 30% of national farmland in the nexus AoE (a single peak, not a nationwide network: the capital's hinterland is the garden of the west, the northern harbor-towns farm ordinary ground) = x1.075 overall. NOT YET DRAINED: Verdannis's front (ruling 88) has not reached the coast - the one dense Green still standing; its failure and Anaveth's answering shunt (ruling 91) are the act-1 countdown.
land_budget.kcal_per_ha_year_basis: ruling 27 default: temperate west-coast mixed farming, the continental 2.5M blend - not paddy (Lunavar), not dry plains; nexus bonus already in the effective-hectare count.
land_budget.sea_diet_frac_basis: ruling 90 - the Goldenport-scoped SECOND exception to ruling 27's fish set-aside (Lunavar's marsh, ruling 62, was the first): inshore/enclosed waters are blight-corruptible (ruling 62's water-sheet logic extended seaward) but pelagic deep-sea stocks stay clean, and only Goldenport has the blue-water fleet (ruling 87) - the best fishery on the continent is a capability, not a coastline. Deep-sea catch feeds 25% of normal human calories (below Lunavar's marsh third, above everyone else's set-aside zero).
land_budget.livestock_units_per_person_basis: ruling 27 default cattle-country blend - coastal lowland pasture, no structural reason to deviate (Ben: defaults elsewhere).
land_budget.population_basis: Lunavar-method (rulings 89-90): area 756,359 (redrawn layer, islands incl.) - 4.9% water = 719,297 dry; x20% cleared = 143,859 raw; x1.075 nexus = 154,649 km2 effective -> 15.465M ha x 2.5M = 38.66T kcal/yr; P = 38.66T / (730k x (1-0.25 sea) + 9.125M x 0.26 LU) = 38.66T / 2.92M = ~13.2M - mid-table (Corvaine 18.0 > Thalendor 14.5 > Goldenport 13.2 > Lunavar 11.6 > Malcurr 7.8): prosperous by wealth and margin, not headcount. Herd ~3.43M units; fleet catch ~2.4T kcal/yr uncounted production. FAMINE: layer 1 (15% arable blight-locked) leaves land at ~85% = 32.9T >> the ~7.25T land-share of human need; full-cull cliff at ~19% of normal land yield with the sea intact - the deepest margin on the continent, which IS the Sec1a claim that Goldenport absorbs layer 1 without noticing. Inshore/estuary catch untrusted (ruling 90) - already outside the counted 25%, which is deep-sea.

nations.name: Ashkar
nations.region: southwest mesa badlands — the new tenth nation (collapsed/anarchic state)

land_budget.water_frac_basis: measured 2026-07-21 (scripts/map/water_frac.py; calibration Thalendor 14.8% vs recorded 14.7% OK). Composition measured by component: the west lake chain ~12,000 km2 of paint (bbox x 293-525 y 2346-2528, drains SW to the sea - Ashkar's one river-to-sea run), the NE tributary basin ~7,100 km2, Lake Vespera's western share ~4,400 km2 (ruling 100 reproduced), three small tarns. The interior is the continent's driest: 74% of land >100 km from any drawn fresh water (Canticle runs 61%), mean distance 256 km.
land_budget.cleared_frac_basis: Ben ruling 126: pocket agriculture - real farmland concentrates where the water is (the west lake chain, the NE tributary valley, the Vespera shore, coastal oasis strips), ~13% of the settled rim (33% of area at <=25 km fresh / <=50 km sea, ~299,000 km2). Well under Canticle's 40%-of-rim (6.5% national, a river-plain rim): Ashkar's pockets are smaller and badland-soiled.
land_budget.yield_mult_basis: no named or derivable leyline yield bonus - Ashkar's ground is Red/Blue (ruling 35), neither a growth frequency; the ruling-63 pattern pins no Green line through the mesas.
land_budget.kcal_per_ha_year_basis: ruling 126, the Canticle precedent verbatim (ruling 102): the pockets ARE the watered land - the mixed blend applies, no dryland penalty; the aridity already lives in the cleared dial.
land_budget.livestock_units_per_person_basis: ruling 126: the default crop-fed 0.26 (ruling 27 class), goat-heavy species mix for mesa country.
land_budget.range_diet_frac_basis: ruling 126: the mesa interior is herd-and-caravan country like Canticle's pan (ruling 102's 0.20), but rock-and-scrub, not grass plain - a thinner range share. At the ruling-102 ~10% grass-conversion floor this puts ~400k LU of range herds in the mesa country, uncounted by the farmland math.
land_budget.coast_diet_frac_basis: ruling 126 - the FOURTH scoped exception to ruling 27's fish set-aside (after Lunavar's marsh 62, Goldenport's sea 90, Canticle's range 102). Ben: 'like Goldenport - they can fish.' On a desert coast the sea is not marginal, it is why the coast is habitable - a tenth of human calories, ~244G kcal/yr, off the south and west coasts and the bay at city-29. The set-aside stands everywhere inland.
land_budget.population_basis: the pocket-and-coast model (ruling 126): P = F / (0.75 x 730k + 0.26 x 9.125M) = 9.775T / 2.92M = ~3.35M NORMAL-TIMES - WHICH FOR ASHKAR MEANS PRE-COLLAPSE. The 5th-largest land (893,896 km2) carrying the second-smallest measured people (above only Vorsk's 3.2M) - the aridity structure is the answer, Canticle-class but harder: 67% dead interior (~595,000 km2 of mesa badlands). Implied ~86 persons/km2 farmland - above the 80 midpoint, honestly earned by the range and sea legs (Vorsk-pattern). Margin invariant: normal-times Ashkar fed itself with the standard convertible buffer (crop-fed herd ~4.3x human crop draw; full-cull cliff at ~18.8% of normal yield) - NO structural hunger, and canon claims none: the status is collapse, not famine. The catastrophe was never caloric - the land could still feed a nation; what broke was the people holding it (ruling 52). CURRENT population is NOT this number: the post-collapse discount (die-off + exodus + untended pockets) is section 2's gated dial.
land_budget.note: Normal-times = pre-collapse budget (ruling 126). area 893,896 - 2.8% water = 868,867 dry; x4.5% cleared = 39,099 raw = effective (no leyline bonus). Production 9.775T kcal/yr; humans draw 1.833T from crops (75% of need - range 15%, sea 10%), crop-fed herd 7.942T. Approved by Ben 2026-07-21 (Ashkar dive, section 1).
land_budget.current_population_basis: ruling 130 (section 2): ~40% of the ~3.35M pre-collapse baseline after ~4 decades - roughly a third emigrated (Goldenport's unwritten, the Lunavar border, Canticle's rim), a third lost to slow attrition (thirst-years, hold wars, the seal-era wasting), a third holds on (coast towns, west lake chain, tributary valley, warlord holds). Deliberately under-peopled: the pockets could carry far more, so holds fight over people not ground. The land_budget's population_normal (~3.35M, ruling 126) stays the pre-collapse baseline the carrying-capacity chain derives; this is the current headcount on that land.

nations.name: Canticle
nations.region: southeast plains/desert, south of the great meandering river

land_budget.water_frac_basis: measured 2026-07-20 (W28 section 1): Rivers-and-Lakes LAYER alpha inside the polygon (water_frac.py, Thalendor calibration OK) - the driest nation measured; the Palewater border strip + the west-lake shore-touch are nearly all of it.
land_budget.cleared_frac_basis: W28 section-2 dial (Ben approved 2026-07-20, ruling 102): farmland exists ONLY on the habitable rim - measured ~246k km2 (16.6% of the nation within 25 km of fresh water / 50 km of sea; 61% of the land is >100 km from ANY water, ruling 99) - farmed intensively at ~40% where the water is: 0.166 x 0.40 = 0.065 national. Aridity is the structural answer to biggest-land-NOT-biggest-people.
land_budget.yield_mult_basis: no nexus or dense-line bonus: none is forced by existing geometry (ruling 11 field model; contrast Goldenport's ruling-89 nexus and Thalendor's Root Network). Deliberately 1.0; a future line ruling would revisit.
land_budget.kcal_per_ha_year_basis: ruling 27 blend: the rim IS the watered land (the cleared dial already excluded the dry interior), so temperate mixed farming applies - no paddy, no dryland penalty (double-count guard: aridity lives in cleared_frac, not here).
land_budget.range_diet_frac_basis: ruling 102 - the THIRD scoped exception to ruling 27's uncounted-food set-aside (Lunavar marsh ruling 62, Goldenport sea ruling 90): the interior range herds graze grass the farmland math never counts and feed a fifth of human calories (meat/milk). At ~10% grass-to-food conversion this floors the range herd at ~1.28M LU walking the pan country.
land_budget.livestock_units_per_person_basis: ruling 27 default for the CROP-FED herd only; the structural pastoral story lives in range_diet_frac (the range herds are extra, uncounted production).
land_budget.population_basis: Lunavar-method (ruling 102): area 1,483,502 - 1.8% water = 1,456,799 dry; x6.5% cleared = 94,692 km2 = 9.47M ha x 2.5M = 23.67T kcal/yr; P = 23.67T / (730k x (1-0.20 range) + 9.125M x 0.26 LU) = 23.67T / 2.957M = ~8.0M - density cross-check 94,692 x 80/km2 = 7.6M OK. Rank: Corvaine 18.0 > Thalendor 14.5 > Goldenport 13.2 > Lunavar 11.6 > Canticle 8.0 > Malcurr 7.8 - the biggest land, the fifth people. Crop-fed herd ~2.08M LU + ~1.28M-LU range floor. FAMINE: layer 1 (15% arable locked) leaves 20.1T >> the 4.68T human crop share; full-cull cliff ~19.8% of normal yield, and the range herds are a second, separate buffer (not immune - ruling 24 locks ground AND stock - just uncounted): Canticle absorbs layer 1 without noticing, which IS Sec1a's surplus claim.

nations.name: Corvaine
nations.region: mid-east, between the central forest and Canticle

land_budget.water_frac_basis: re-measured 2026-07-19 on the redrawn map: Rivers-and-Lakes LAYER alpha inside the new polygon (direct layer measure, no colour classifier). Previous basis: measured 2026-07-14: 9.1% Rivers-and-Lakes blue inside the polygon (scripts/map/water_frac.py on thyrcross.png; classifier calibrated against Thalendor's recorded 11.7%, reproduced at 11.5%); the Palewater bank and the eastern river-meets
land_budget.cleared_frac_basis: Ben ruling 28: a river-plain monarchy out-clears forest-capped Thalendor (15%); woodland along the forest border, marshy river-meets, and royal preserves keep it moderate
land_budget.yield_mult_basis: ruling 28: no named leyline ridge or nexus boosts Corvaine's fields - the Black Altar collects souls, not harvests
land_budget.kcal_per_ha_year_basis: ruling 27 dial, shared continent-wide: net-of-seed digestible energy, pre-industrial mixed farming blended over crop/fallow/pasture. Adjustable; the starvation cliff tracks it.
land_budget.population_basis: farmland ONLY (rulings 26-28, re-derived ruling 85 on the redrawn area): ruling-85 chain 919,645 km2 - 2.0% water = 901,252 dry x 25% cleared = 225,313 raw = effective (no leyline yield bonus) x 80/km2 = ~18.0M. Calorie balance (ruling 27, rescaled): 22.53M ha x 2.5M kcal/ha = 56.33T kcal/yr; humans 18.0M x 730k = 13.14T (~23.3%); remaining 43.2T feeds ~4.73M cattle-equivalent livestock units (~0.26/person). FAMINE (ruling 28, scale-invariant per ruling 85): layer-1 only (85% yield) leaves Corvaine CALORICALLY WHOLE; herds cull ~20%; the desperation behind the writ-raids stays institutional, not caloric; cliff at 23.4%.
land_budget.note: Normal-times farmland (rulings 28/85). Chain uses ruling-85 area 919,645 km2 (area_km2_approx is the same redrawn-polygon measure, rounded separately). The 9.1% -> 2.0% water drop is a boundary effect of the redraw (the wash stops at the channel), not hydrology.

Named 'the Hush' - law binds only when performed before witnesses, and the pan swallows sound and holds none: 'gone to the Hush' = beyond any court's reach.
